note: Incident anchors on the Phase 1 street slice: where a tactical incident can start from the beat. One flat, one street corner. Kept beside the street map so the encounter and the street cannot drift apart.

anchors.label: Block C, flat fourteen
anchors.brief: A neighbour called in a printing press that runs all night. The stair door is barred from the inside.

anchors.label: Canal market corner
anchors.brief: Ration cut at the depot this morning. Two hundred people, no permit, and one of the organisers is on the list.

anchors.label: Grocer on Fourth
anchors.brief: Suspected contraband in the stockroom. Front door is locked, alley door barred.

anchors.label: Tax bureau branch office
anchors.brief: Silent alarm triggered at the branch office. Manager is unaccounted for.
